# Third-party notices

Generated by `./gradlew :standalone:icons:generateIcons` from the upstream licence files; edit
`generate-icons.gradle.kts`, not this file.

Every icon in `dev.voir.areca:icons`, except the three sign-in marks listed under
Trademarks, is converted from Lucide or Tabler Icons into an `ImageVector` builder. Its KDoc
names the upstream icon and licence ("Converted from Lucide `x` (ISC)" or "Converted from
Tabler Icons `x` (MIT)"). Those licences require the notices below in all copies, including
the copies other Areca modules bundle. It ships in each such artifact under `META-INF/`.

## Trademarks

Brand icons (Tabler `brand-*` drawings: `BrandApple`, `BrandAndroid`, `Codepen`, `Figma`,
`Framer`, `GoogleChrome` and `Youtube`) depict trademarks of their owners. The icon licences
above cover the drawings, not the marks; their presence implies no endorsement.

`SocialApple`, `SocialFacebook` and `SocialGoogle` are the providers' own sign-in marks: Apple
is a trademark of Apple Inc., Facebook of Meta Platforms, Inc., and Google of Google LLC. They
are not covered by the icon licences above. They are included for sign-in buttons and must
be used as each provider's sign-in branding guidelines require.
